businesses.business: beauty products (fragrances, cosmetics, skin and body care)

offering_description.value: Designs, markets and sells prestige and mass-market fragrances, color cosmetics, skin care, hair care and body care products. Sells to retailers, distributors and consumers worldwide through owned and licensed brands. Production is carried out in company and contract facilities.

primary_products.value: fragrances; color cosmetics; skin care; hair care and nail products; body care

customer_segment.value: B2B: department stores, perfumeries, mass retailers, travel retail operators, distributors; B2C: individual beauty and fragrance consumers via online and direct channels

end_markets.value: prestige beauty; mass-market beauty; professional salon hair care; consumer skin and body care

revenue_model.value: product sales: fragrance, cosmetics, skin and hair care products sold to retailers, distributors and consumers; licensing or royalties: some brands licensed out to partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and licenses beauty brands, markets products sold to retailers and consumers; OEM / manufacturer: produces and fills beauty products from purchased ingredients and packaging, with contract manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Asia Pacific, and travel retail worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: fragrances, color cosmetics, skin care, hair and body care sharing beauty retail channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: department stores, perfumeries, drugstores, mass retailers, travel retail; distributors / dealers: distributors in international markets; online: brand websites and e-commerce retailers; direct sales: professional salon accounts and key retail accounts
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; distributors / dealers; online; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cosmetics safety and labeling rules from FDA, EU Cosmetics Regulation, and chemical and environmental rules
